THE GAP THIS CLOSES (your ask, Aug 28)
Both maps ended at "services authorized." Real life starts after: Is delivery matching the promise? What lanes exist besides traditional? What's the ladder when it goes wrong?

Same honesty rules as everything shipped: real clocks only, every claim cited, one lever per stage.

CITATIONS TO VERIFY AT BUILD (before any copy ships — the provenance guard enforces registration mechanically):
· Ed Code §56345(a)(3) progress-report cadence
· W&I §4710.5 appeal windows (60d / 30d aid-paid-pending)
· §4731 20-working-day response
· 34 CFR §300.148 10-business-day notice
· current DDS scope of participant-directed services in traditional POS

OPEN QUESTIONS — your call before I build:
1 · Pathways compare: RC map only, or a school variant too (district services vs NPA vs 504-only)?
2 · Should "Check the data" auto-create a recurring tracker reminder each grading period?
3 · Escalation ladder: inline stage card (artboard 1, compact) or the full ladder screen (artboard 2)? Mockup shows both — pick one or keep both (card links to ladder).

BUILD PLAN AFTER YOUR GO
1 · Content + provenance: new stages trilingual (en/es/vi), progress_data_request letter + sent moment, pathway data in a pure module; register every citation.
2 · Pathways compare component on the RC map, PathDecider beneath.
3 · Derivation: RC active + IPP confirmed → "Living with services"; school active → "Check the data".
